title: 1st Billboard Music Awards (1990) — Top Artist: Top Artist: MC Hammer
t: 1st Billboard Music Awards (1990) — Top Artist: Top Artist: MC Hammer
description:
1st Billboard Music Awards — held December 10, 1990 at Barker Hangar, Santa Monica. Hosted by Paul Shaffer.

The top honor, Top Artist, went to Top Artist: MC Hammer. Hammer's pop-rap explosion made him the chart year's defining artist.

The first BBMAs aired as a year-end chart celebration — winners determined by data, not votes.

This ceremony belongs to the Billboard / Dick Clark Productions's long arc from its founding to the present: each year's winners capture what the Billboard valued most — the films, records, shows, and books that defined their moment.
